# case: record-txt-long

## check

## bind
; DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
; The records below are what the changed sets hold afterwards;
; every other record of the zone stays as it is.
$ORIGIN example.com.

; long.example.com TXT (DKIM); the other TXT records of long stay
; replaces the DKIM record of long
long 3600 IN TXT "v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA" "AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA"
## route53
{

  "Changes": [
    {
      "Action": "UPSERT",
      "ResourceRecordSet": {
        "Name": "long.example.com.",
        "Type": "TXT",
        "TTL": 3600,
        "ResourceRecords": [
          {
            "Value": "\"v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA\" \"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA\""
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}
## route53 notes
fix.fn.incomplete {"name":"long.example.com","type":"TXT"}
## cloudflare
#!/bin/sh
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# Needs an API token that may edit this zone's DNS records (Zone > DNS > Edit) and the zone ID
# (the zone's Overview page). Neither is written here: set both in your shell first.
: "${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN:?set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN to your API token}"
: "${CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID:?set CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID to the zone ID of example.com}"
API="https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/$CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID/dns_records"

# 1. Delete the long.example.com TXT (DKIM) records there now (they were not read)
#    Find their ids (none: skip this step), then:
curl -sS "$API?type=TXT&name=long.example.com" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"
curl -sS -X DELETE "$API/RECORD_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"

# 2. Add long.example.com TXT "v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA" "AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA"
curl -sS -X POST "$API" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"type":"TXT","name":"long.example.com","content":"\"v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA\" \"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA\"","ttl":3600}'
## cloudflare notes
fix.fn.cloudflare-ids {}
## octodns
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# In the zone's YAML (example.com.yaml): set these entries; the other names stay as they are.
---
long:
  # keep the other TXT values this name has; replace its DKIM value with the one below
  - ttl: 3600
    type: TXT
    values:
      - 'v=DKIM1\; k=rsa\; '
## octodns notes
fix.fn.incomplete {"name":"long.example.com","type":"TXT"}
## terraform-cloudflare
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# terraform-provider-cloudflare v4 (cloudflare_record; v5 names it cloudflare_dns_record).
variable "cloudflare_zone_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The zone ID of example.com"
}

# remove the resources of any other long.example.com TXT (DKIM) record (the current ones were not read)

resource "cloudflare_record" "txt_long" {
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = "long.example.com"
  type     = "TXT"
  content  = "v=DKIM1; k=rsa; "
  ttl      = 3600
}
## terraform-route53
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# aws_route53_record manages a whole record set: every value of the name and type is listed.
variable "route53_zone_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The hosted zone ID of example.com"
}

# list the other TXT values of long.example.com here too (they were not read): this resource replaces the whole set

resource "aws_route53_record" "txt_long" {
  zone_id = var.route53_zone_id
  name    = "long.example.com"
  type    = "TXT"
  ttl     = 3600
  records = ["v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA\"\"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA"]
}
## terraform-route53 notes
fix.fn.incomplete {"name":"long.example.com","type":"TXT"}
## en
DNS change request: example.com

Please make the following changes in the DNS zone example.com. Records not listed here stay as they are.

1. Replace: DKIM record (TXT)
   Name: long.example.com
   Value:
     "v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA" "AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA"
   TTL: 3600
   Replace the name’s DKIM record with the value above.
   The other TXT records of the name stay as they are.

Once the change is made, this link shows whether public DNS resolvers see it:
https://example.github.io/domainscope/#/change/check?z=example.com&r=is+long+TXT+%22v=DKIM1;+k=rsa;+p=AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA%22+%22AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA%22
## tr
DNS değişiklik talebi: example.com

Lütfen example.com DNS zone’unda aşağıdaki değişiklikleri yapın. Burada yer almayan kayıtlar olduğu gibi kalır.

1. Değiştir: DKIM kaydı (TXT)
   Ad: long.example.com
   Değer:
     "v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA" "AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA"
   TTL: 3600
   Adın DKIM kaydını yukarıdaki değerle değiştirin.
   Adın diğer TXT kayıtları olduğu gibi kalır.

Değişiklik yapıldıktan sonra genel DNS çözümleyicilerinin onu görüp görmediğini bu bağlantı gösterir:
https://example.github.io/domainscope/#/change/check?z=example.com&r=is+long+TXT+%22v=DKIM1;+k=rsa;+p=AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA%22+%22AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA%22
